messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick Q — Ill be on unpaid parental leave ~8 weeks starting June 1. Does unpaid leave pause 401k employer match vesting or service accrual? Trying to plan timelines.
jamal-eng: depends on the plan language. which vendor/plan doc are we on?
alex-finance: We use the plan listed in the benefits portal. Vesting is graded (20% @1yr, 40% @2yr, 60% @3yr, 80% @4yr, 100% @5yr). Generally employer match contributions stop during unpaid pay periods (no payroll deferrals to match), but vesting/service rules vary. Long unpaid leaves can pause service unless covered under protected leave (FMLA).
maria-peopleops: Can you link the plan doc?
alex-finance: https://benefits.redwood.com/retirement/plan-summary (internal). See "Service and Leave" and the footnote about leaves longer than 13 weeks.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit your leave request in the People Portal so payroll and benefits are logged. Submit: https://people.redwood.com/leave-request :spiral_calendar:
maria-peopleops: Will unpaid leave affect employer match for the period I'm out, or just vesting?
alex-finance: Two things: (1) Match contributions — if no earned pay, usually no match deposited for that pay period. (2) Vesting/service — some plans treat certain leaves (FMLA, military, jury duty) as continuous service; others pause after a threshold. I'm confirming with benefits@redwood whether parental leave coded as FMLA here counts as continuous service for vesting.
jamal-eng: @alex-finance can you cc benefits@redwood? thanks.
alex-finance: Looping them in now and opened case with plan admin: Case# 2026-0458. Asked whether FMLA-coded parental leave counts toward continuous service for vesting.
maria-peopleops: If vesting pauses, is there typically a buyback/make-up option to restore service?
alex-finance: Some plans allow make-up service via repaid missed contributions or employer policy to restore service; vendor-specific. If the leave qualifies as FMLA, many vendors treat it as continuous service. I'll share vendor response here.
hr-bot: Leave request for maria-peopleops submitted — status: pending manager approval.
alex-finance: Vendor response (2026-02-05): for parental leave coded as FMLA/approved parental leave, our plan admin confirmed it does NOT interrupt service for vesting. Employer match contributions will not be made for unpaid pay periods, but service accrual for vesting continues. I'll update the benefits doc and post the confirmation email here.
